description: Kukulcan Space + Hiveflow: a Mexican team building an AI agent swarm that reads NASA's PSI microgravity combustion data (BASS, Saffire, FLEX, ACME, SAME), ranks and cross-checks the findings, and turns them into fire-safety insights for a 30% oxygen Moon Base, with a human expert approving every result. Looking for: Python/data science, combustion or physics, React/data viz, and storytelling/video. We speak Spanish & English.
